summary: Creates a planar grid of rows and columns as POP points, with optional triangle, quad, line, line-strip, point-primitive, or points-only connectivity. It can orient the grid on XY, YZ, or ZX planes and outputs dimension metadata.

key_params.name: linetype
key_params.note: Line strip or independent line primitive output for line connectivity

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: XY, YZ, or ZX plane orientation

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use connected input POP bounds as the starting plane bounds

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Plane size along U and V

key_params.name: anchoru
key_params.note: Anchor the U side at the origin

key_params.name: anchorv
key_params.note: Anchor the V side at the origin

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Create point or vertex texture coordinates

common_gotchas: Plane POP emits dimension metadata numCols by numRows; preserve it when GLSL or lookup logic depends on _Dim.
Rows and columns line connectivity differ from quad or triangle topology; choose based on downstream line vs surface processing.
Texture coordinate component meaning follows plane orientation, so YZ and ZX planes swap the intuitive axes.
